answer_1.quote: ...We utilized the DA score prediction data released with WMT22 QE shared task. This dataset includes the source ... MT output ... and (post-edited) human references for eight language pairs, i.e., English‑German (EN‑DE), English‑Marathi (EN‑MR), English‑Chinese (EN‑ZH), Estonian‑English (ET‑EN), Nepali‑English (NE‑EN), Romanian‑English (RO‑EN), Russian‑English (RU‑EN) and Sinhala‑English (SI‑EN).
answer_1.outputs: Predicted Direct Assessment (DA) quality scores for machine‑translated sentences

answer_2.quote: ...Spearman correlation was used to evaluate how the predicted scores are correlated with the (mean of) human annotated scores.

answer_3.quote: ...For LLMs to predict translation quality, our prompt includes 1) instructions to perform the task such as "Score the following translation", and 2) translation information such as source or reference. We explore zero‑shot, Chain‑of‑Thought (CoT) and few‑shot prompting to have the LLM output a DA score.
